requirements.normative_requirement: VM startup is amortized at lease scope while per-call security state remains fresh.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Security weakened for speed or latency excessive

requirements.normative_requirement: Adapter, protocol, structured-tool, process-cell, export, and cleanup overheads are benchmarked independently.
requirements.primary_verification: Reproducible benchmark suite with p50/p95/p99 and payload distributions.

requirements.normative_requirement: Batch admission cannot violate the configured realtime/voice resource and queue budget.
The Pi event loop and D0 call completion path perform no long scan, process wait, durable fsync, database checkpoint, or controller maintenance.
requirements.primary_verification: Event-loop delay instrumentation under heavy tool activity.

requirements.normative_requirement: D0 and D1 admission latency are measured and reported separately through p99.
requirements.threat_or_failure: D0 and D1 latency hidden in one average

requirements.normative_requirement: Release evidence includes local-inference and voice-active contention with PSI and model latency.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Pressure and model latency ignored in admission
requirements.primary_verification: PSI/inference threshold and voice-active p99 campaign.
